title: Filipino-Style Pork Blood Stew (Dinuguan)
description: A rich and savory Filipino stew made with crispy pork blood, pork belly, and other essential flavorings. Typically served with steamed rice or puto.
instructions: In a large pan, sauté the pork belly until crispy.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped pork blood and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the vinegar, patis, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Simmer the mixture for 10-15 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the dinuguan hot with steamed rice or puto.
